Name: Faster Time
Author: iqcp1
Description:
Stardew has a lot of waiting in it — waiting for a shop to open, waiting out
a rainy day, waiting for the clock to hit 2am so you can pass out and move on.
This mod lets you skip that.

FEATURES
- Press F6 to cycle the clock speed: normal -> 2x -> 3x -> 4x -> back to normal.
- Press F7 to jump straight back to normal speed at any time.
- An on-screen message tells you the current speed every time it changes.
- Your choice is saved automatically and restored next time you play.

CONFIGURATION
Edit config.json in the mod folder to change the hotkeys, the speed steps, or
turn off the on-screen messages. Any list of speeds works, not just 2/3/4.

NOTES
- Festivals and cutscenes are left alone; the game controls the clock there.
- Safe to add to an existing save, and safe to remove at any time.

INSTALL
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip this into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Want the opposite? See my "Longer Days" mod, which stretches the day out
instead. The two are completely separate and can be installed together.
